admission.justification: Three registered cases pin the admission, the rerun and the earlier-refresh answer, and the judgment spans the writer's pure function, its row authoring and the stored shape. Without it a curator whose code moved is refused twice by advice that points at itself and has no route to say where the code now lives.

applicability: A still_rejected reconsideration row whose fired reconsider_on link names code the leaf removed or moved, at the leaf's code candidate.
conditions: repoint is a list of {link, path, locator}; link is the 0-based position of a fired reconsider_on link of the answered alternative, named once.

An anchor or anchor_stale item needs a fired base target with no image at C and the leaf's link still the base target or already this same re-point; a link that still maps is refreshed as today and a re-point on it is refused.
The new path and locator resolve at C through the code snapshot, with the blob and content C holds.

For anchor and anchor_stale, the leaf's current link is the base target, or already names this same re-point so a rerun writes the same bytes; for refresh_not_current, the row names that item in items and the current link is the earlier refresh the item fired on, or this same re-point.
The row records before and after with their paths, and the decision's revision goes up once in the leaf.
exclusions: A raise: it leaves the links as they are and asks the developer where the code lives.
relation and alternative, which a re-point never changes.
Requirement links, which are re-pointed by version as today.
Undoing a re-point: if the removed code returns, the re-point stands.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_reconsideration_repoint.py (10 tests), all passed 2026-10-21, on real Git trees made by the leaf test support

statement: A still_rejected row may re-point a fired link the leaf's change took out from under it, naming the old target, the new one and the reason: an anchor or anchor_stale item needs a fired base target with no image at C and the link still at its base target or already that same re-point, and a refresh_not_current item needs the row to name it and the link to hold the earlier refresh or this same re-point.
